entities.summary: Eric Singer is an American drummer. Known as a drummer and vocalist in the hard rock band Kiss across three stints, he has also performed with artists such as Black Sabbath, Alice Cooper, Lita Ford, Badlands, Brian May and Gary Moore as well as his own band ESP. In his career, Singer has appeared on over 75 albums and 11 EPs.
